summary: 150053568350107_1421801313303485 admin July 22, 2026 Cameco is proud to support the World Nuclear University , which is now holding its annual Summer Institute program. The Summer Institute is a great place for young professionals in the nuclear industry to connect with mentors and develop leadership skills – and we’re particularly excited to have two of our own employees attending.
